posts.title: A guide to this MoviMoon preview
posts.excerpt: How the catalogue, region preference, and optional integrations work.
posts.body:
This article is local sample content used while no Blogger export, CMS, or D1 database is configured. Replace it with posts you own or are authorized to publish.

The global Trending list is distinct from the region-selected popularity and release-date discovery feed. No IP geolocation is used.

posts.title: Connecting approved data and playback sources
posts.excerpt: A short checklist for adding sources you control.
posts.body: Use a server-side API secret for catalogue requests. For playback, configure only an authorized HTTPS embed URL on an exact allow-listed origin. This preview includes no stream URL or full-length media.

pages.title: About MoviMoon
pages.excerpt: A Blogger-theme experience rebuilt as a static interface plus optional Pages Functions services.
pages.body: The interface can use TMDB through a server-side Pages Functions proxy, but the API is intentionally disabled until an owner supplies a credential as a Pages Secret. Posts and pages can come from D1 or this JSON adapter. Player integration is disabled until an authorized source and exact HTTPS origin are configured.
